jobs.title: Student Assistant - Clinical Data Insights & Transformation
jobs.location: Søborg, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
jobs.description_md:
**Location:** Søborg

**Your impact begins here**

As a Student Assistant in Clinical Data Insights & Transformation, you will help turn clinical data into insights that support decision-making in clinical development. You will review and quality-check data, build clear visualisations and support pilots that bring AI and digital tools into everyday ways of working. Your work helps colleagues trust the data they rely on and act on it sooner, while you build hands-on experience at the intersection of data, analytics and technology.

**What you’ll bring**

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within life science, health science, data science, IT or a related field. You also:

•         Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

•         Enjoy working with data and digital tools.

•         Are curious about AI and emerging technologies.

•         Work in a structured and independent manner.

•         Communicate confidently in English.

•         Are comfortable collaborating across teams and functions.

**Useful, but not essential:**

Experience with Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, Python, AI tools or other analytics platforms. If you have not used them yet, you will have the chance to learn.

**What you’ll do**

You will support a range of activities across data analytics, process improvement and digital transformation. We will shape the role around your strengths, so your focus may vary. You can expect to:

•         Support data review and apply quality checks to collected clinical data.

•         Clean data using listings, reporting and dashboards.

•         Develop visualisations and presentations that communicate key insights clearly.

•         Assist with process improvement and support AI-related pilots.

•         Keep study documentation and data listings accurate.

•         Support workshops, meetings and change management activities.

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join the Clinical Data Insights & Transformation team, based in Søborg, Denmark. The team works to strengthen data-driven decision-making and to improve how clinical data is reviewed and used across clinical development. It is a collaborative group with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement and creating value through data and technology.

You will work alongside skilled colleagues in an international environment and collaborate across teams and functions. By bringing different perspectives together and speaking up when something can work better, you will help the team move from data to action with clarity.

**What you can expect here**

This is a student assistant position of **up to 15 hours per week.** You will work on real tasks that matter to clinical development, with colleagues who share what they know and give honest feedback. You will build practical skills in data analytics, digital tools and AI, and the role is tailored to your strengths so you can learn, grow and contribute from the start.

**Salary and Benefits**

This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is 209,27 DKK, based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn clinical data into insight and help shape how clinical development uses data, analytics and technology, apply for the Student Assistant - Clinical Data Insights & Transformation role by **8 November**

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Student Worker - Design and Asset Governance
jobs.description_md:
**Job Description**

Does *Bringing LEGO Play to gaming and gamers to LEGO Play* sounds energizing? 

We are looking for an enthusiastic student worker to our GAME team in Billund Denmark, who can help us deliver fantastic on brand gaming experiences.  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Support reviews of in-game content, assets and creative deliverables against LEGO brand and design guidelines.

* Maintain governance tools and records, including assets trackers, review boards, status reports and supporting documentation.

* Assist in creating and updating internal guidance knowledge resources, such as confluence pages, process documentation.

* General support for ad-hoc tasks and activities.

**Play your part in our team succeeding**

As a student worker, you will join our GAME team and be part of the Game Design and Assets Governance team, to support and ensure that in-game content and creative assets align with brand guidelines and quality standards, contributing to operational excellence across teams. At the same time, you will gain valuable insight into how game content and assets are created, reviewed and integrated throughout the game development process, offering an unique opportinitey to learn about the intersection of creativity, gaming and brand governance.  

 

The Gaming environment at the LEGO Group is a growing strategy area, where collaboration with some of the biggest players in the world has placed an increased focus on game content approval and operational excellence. 

**Do you have what it takes?**

* You are able to work at a minimum of 10-15 hours per week in our office at Havremarken in Billund

* We imagine that you are a first year master lever sudent, or in the final year of your bachelor degree. Your educational focus is business-related such as Marketing, Communications, Graphic/Visual/Multimedia Design, Game Design/Development, or equivaltent.

* You are passionate about the Business of the Gaming Industry and are eager to learn new stuff with a go-do attitude

* You are comfortable with working independently in a trusting and virtual environment

* You have strong communication skills and a high attention to detail

* You have the ability to approach tasks both with structure and process, and creative oriented mindset

* English at a professional level

* Open mind to technical environment and strong IT skills across the Microsoft suite (primarilly Excel, PowrePoint, Word), additional skills like Miro could be a plus.

 

We fully respect and expect that you are dedicated to your studies. Thus working hours will be adapted to this. 

• Can manage with close supervision, tasks are assigned with explanation
• Ability to work as part of a team
• A positive attitude and willingness to learn

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**What’s in it for you?**

Here is what you can expect:

**Family Care Leave** - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

**Insurances** – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

**Wellbeing** - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

**Colleague Discount** – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

**Bonus** - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

**Your workplace:** Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.

**Hybrid Working:** Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience [here](https://www.lego.com/careers/why-join-us)

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

**Join the LEGO® team today.**

jobs.title: Associate Analyst Student position in the Operations team
jobs.description_md:
With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

You will join a collaborative team where your work helps keep operations running smoothly and staffing information reliable. You will gain insight into how Resource Management, Operations and subcontractor processes work together in a large professional services organization. We will help you learn our tools and processes and give you meaningful responsibility as you develop.

You can also expect:

* Responsibility and room to grow: An opportunity to shape parts of your role around your strengths and interests.
* Continuous learning: Ongoing coaching and knowledge sharing with the team.
* Flexibility: Working hours that can be balanced with your studies.

**About the job**

You will support Operations & Resource Management in Deloitte Technology & Transformation. Your work will span expense approvals, external subcontractor administration, staffing bookings and reporting. You will collaborate with colleagues across the business, take ownership of your tasks and help keep the information our teams rely on accurate and up to date.

The role is approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to balance your work with your studies. You must be available 1-2 hours each week day to process expenses.

**Your assignments**

You will combine day-to-day administration with follow-up, coordination and careful maintenance of our systems. Your responsibilities will include:

* Review and proces daily expense submissions in accordance with applicable processes and guidelines
* Support our work with subcontractors by creating external profiles and assignments in our booking system, maintaining the subcontractor pool, and preparing draft contracts for review
* Support with bookings and preparing recurring reports for specific service areas
* Helping with holiday reporting and manage the Resource Management shared inbox.
* Carry out monthly CV clean-up, follow up on staffing tickets and maintain Resource Management intranet pages, including work to consolidate relevant Nordic page.

You are enrolled in a relevant higher education programme and enjoy work that requires attention to detail and sound judgement. You organise your tasks, follow through on commitments and know when to ask for input. You are comfortable checking information, spotting discrepancies and communicating clearly with different stakeholders.

You are confident using digital tools and spreadsheets and willing to learn our booking and reporting systems. Experience in administration, coordination or reporting is welcome but not essential. What matters most is a proactive approach, a willingness to learn and the ability to handle information with care and discretion. You communicate effectively in English; Danish is an advantage.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Do you want to be part of our team?

**Click the "I am interested" button above** if you are ready to join our team.

Send your application, CV, and grade transcript by 30.10.2026. We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: As soon as possible

Please do not hesitate to contact Line Wiuff, Head of Operations & Head of Nordic Resource Management at [lwiuff@deloitte.dk](mailto:lwiuff@deloitte.dk) if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

**We look forward to connecting with you!**

*In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.*

jobs.title: Junior Consultants (student) within Business, Strategy & Public – start February 2027
jobs.description_md:
**Do you want to help shape the future of Denmark’s largest companies?**

Are you curious, driven, and eager to create tangible results? Are you ready to kickstart your career as a management consultant? If so, you could be PA’s next junior consultant.

We are looking for ambitious students from business, economics, and social science backgrounds to join our highly valued student team. As a junior consultant, you’ll work alongside experienced professionals and clients from the very beginning.

You’ll tackle real client challenges across our diverse industries—helping deliver business transformations, develop operating models, analyse markets, and support strategy design and execution. You’ll collaborate closely with seasoned consultants but also take ownership of your own analyses, deliverables, and responsibilities. This hands-on experience offers a unique opportunity to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

As a junior consultant, you will be involved in many different types of tasks such as:

* Delivering client projects together with a team of experienced consultants.

* Knowledge gathering and analysis work for both internal and external projects.

* Preparing and participating in client interviews, meetings and workshops.

* Participating in long-term internal projects developing new business concepts and strategies.

* Taking ownership of defined workstreams and analyses as part of larger client projects.

* Contributing to proposals and business development across PA's different sectors and capabilities

You will be challenged from the beginning, but you will not be expected to know everything from day one. You will get to work both independently and in teams within a flexible working environment with a deep understanding of your studies. As a student, you will be part of a professional workplace while also having the opportunity to join weekly social activities.   
We believe that value is created in collaboration and by working shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients. You will be part of an international environment where we value teamwork, sparring and feedback. It is also an environment that requires learning and new knowledge so that we can deliver brilliant work to our clients. With us, you will follow the latest developments in the field, while at the same time having access to training and certifications. We are therefore looking for someone with an open and curious approach to solving challenges and who is driven by acquiring new knowledge.   
Your employment starts with a thorough introduction to PA and consulting. From day one, you will also have a dedicated manager and buddy to support your development and help you pursue the areas and projects that match your interests.

* You are in the last year of your bachelor’s degree or the first year of your master's degree.

* You are studying business administration, economics, finance, political science, public administration or another relevant business or social science discipline.

* You are methodically and analytically strong and have the ability to quickly familiarise yourself with and solve complex problems.

* You are among the most talented in your year.

* You are ambitious, enthusiastic, and focused on delivering the best results.

You have good interpersonal and communication skills, and you are fluent in English, both in writing and speech.

If the above sounds interesting to you, do not wait to apply! We will be conducting interviews during November and December. 
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Sanna Austrell at sanna.austrell@paconsulting.com 
 
Send us your CV, application and exam transcripts through our career site. We do not accept applications by email. 
Application deadline: November 15th, 2026.  
**About us** 
We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. As strategies, technologies and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity. Our diverse teams of experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough use of technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results. An innovation and transformation consultancy, we are over 4000 specialists in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport. Our people are strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers and technologists.  
We operate globally from offices across the UK, US, Netherlands and Nordics.  
PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.  
**Inclusion & Diversity**
We believe that diversity makes us a stronger firm and look to employ people with different ideas, styles and skill sets. This diversity stimulates a rich, creative environment – one in which our people develop, and our clients enjoy enduring results. We’re committed to recruiting, promoting and rewarding our people solely based on their ability to contribute to PA’s goals, without regard to their sex, race, disability, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, military service obligation, age or marital status.

“Som studentermedhjælper i Strategisk Sundhed får du en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder analytisk og tæt på vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af et stærkt team, hvor der er plads til at lære og tage ansvar,” siger Rikke Bay Haaber, Chef for Strategisk Sundhed.

 

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at udvikle tilbud og løsninger, der hjælper PFA’s virksomheds- og organisationskunder med at skabe trivsel i arbejdslivet. Du kommer til at udarbejde analyser, oplæg og kundevendte materialer i tæt samarbejde med teamet. Du får en varieret hverdag med både analytiske, kommunikative og praktiske opgaver – og mulighed for at omsætte din viden fra studiet til konkrete leverancer for kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

 

Gør viden skarp og anvendelig for PFA’s kunder

Dine nøgleopgaver bliver at:

Udarbejde og opdatere kundevendte materialer og præsentationer i PowerPoint.
Udarbejde analyser og oplæg til løsninger, der understøtter kundespecifikke value propositions.
Indsamle, strukturere og formidle viden og data, som kan bruges i rådgivningen af HR-ansvarlige og beslutningstagere.
Løse praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med leverancer og kundemøder.
Understøtte teamets administrative opgaver og bidrage til, at kundeaktiviteter bliver gennemført effektivt og professionelt.

 

Hvem er du?

Du læser på en relevant økonomisk uddannelse på KU eller CBS, har gennemført mindst ét års studie og forventer at fortsætte på en kandidatuddannelse med vægt på  kommunikation, HR, organisation, ledelse eller strategi.
Du er en øvet bruger af Excel, PowerPoint og Word og kan præsentere information klart – både skriftligt og visuelt.
Du er udadvendt og opsøgende, når du skal finde viden, data og analyser, der kan understøtte konkrete kundeopgaver.
Du kommunikerer sikkert og præcist på skrift, i tale og gennem visuelle præsentationer.
Du arbejder selvstændigt, grundigt og resultatorienteret – også når opgaverne skal løses hurtigt.
Du er fleksibel i travle perioder og kan tilpasse dig skiftende behov. Samtidig har vi forståelse for, at dit studie kommer først, og du får mulighed for selv at planlægge arbejdsdage og -tider samt holde fri i forbindelse med eksamener.

 

Din nye hverdag  i PFA

Du bliver en del af Strategisk Sundhed, som er en del af Sundhedsområdet i PFA. Teamet består af seks dygtige medarbejdere med bred erfaring inden for trivsel, ledelse, strategi og forretningsudvikling. Stemningen i teamet er uformel. Vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer åbent og har tillid til hinanden, så der er plads til både spørgsmål, idéer og ærlige holdninger.

 

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?   

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Du bliver en del af et inkluderende fællesskab og har mulighed for at deltage i en bred vifte af aktiviteter – fra boksning og løbeklub til fredagscaféer. På tværs af PFA er der mere end 60 studentermedhjælpere, og gennem foreningen PFA Students får du gode muligheder for både faglig og social sparring samt deltagelse i forskellige events. Du kan se frem til gode arbejdsforhold, fx byder køkkenet på frokost til alle kostpræferencer, og du kan købe take away med hjem. Vi er placeret i PFA’s nyrenoverede lokaler i Nordhavn i København, hvor du har let adgang til både Metro og S-tog.

 

Kan du se dig selv i en hverdag som PFA’er? Send os bare dit CV!

Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning. Vedhæft blot dit CV og tilføj et par linjer i dit resumé om, hvorfor du er interesseret i jobbet inden deadline den 8. november 2026.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Rikke Bay Haaber, Chef for Strategisk Sundhed, på +45 24 28 46 33.

jobs.title: Studentermedhjælper til Arbejdsmiljø og HSE
jobs.description_md:
## Om tjenesten

Ansøg senest: **26.11.2026**

Hvor: **Brøndby**

[Ansøg nu!](https://web103.reachmee.com/ext/I003/475/apply?site=30&lang=DK&validator=c1d2c0a95e2806fe1b35af4b5e6c333b&job_id=11831)

### Del annoncen

# Studentermedhjælper til Arbejdsmiljø og HSE

*Er du nysgerrig på arbejdsmiljø, trivsel og organisatoriske processer? Vil du gerne omsætte din teoretiske viden til praksis og få erfaring med at understøtte et sikkert og sundt arbejdsmiljø i en af Nordens største tekniske virksomheder?*

Hos Bravida søger vi en studentermedhjælper til vores HSE-funktion (Health, Safety & Environment) i Brøndby. Du bliver en vigtig støtte for vores HSE-specialist og får indblik i, hvordan arbejdsmiljøarbejde omsættes fra politikker og processer til konkrete handlinger i hverdagen.

Stillingen er oplagt for dig, der interesserer dig for arbejdsmiljø, trivsel, sikkerhed og forebyggelse, og som gerne vil lære mere om, hvordan man understøtter medarbejdere og ledere i at skabe gode og sikre arbejdspladser. Du får grundig oplæring og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med og være support til vores HSE-specialist, som bliver din daglige sparringspartner.

**Dine arbejdsopgaver vil inkludere**

* Assistere med sagsbehandling og administrative opgaver inden for arbejdsmiljøområdet
* Registrering og opfølgning på arbejdsulykker, nærved-hændelser og risikoobservationer
* Bidrage til udarbejdelse og vedligeholdelse af dokumentation, instruktioner og tjeklister
* Indsamling af data samt understøttelse af rapportering, statistik og risikovurderinger
* Deltagelse i relevante møder, uddannelsesaktiviteter og interne HSE-initiativer
* Diverse ad hoc-opgaver og opfølgning på igangværende aktiviteter i samarbejde med HSE-specialisten

**Hvem er du?**

Du behøver ikke have erfaring med HSE eller arbejdsmiljø fra tidligere. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på området og har lyst til at lære.

Vi forestiller os, at du er studerende inden for en samfundsvidenskabelig, administrativ eller humanistisk uddannelse, og at du har mindst ét år tilbage af dit studie.

**Vi forestiller os, at du har/er**

* Studerende på en relevant videregående uddannelse
* Struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at skabe overblik
* Interesseret i arbejdsmiljø, trivsel, sikkerhed og forebyggelse
* Stærk i skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation
* Rutineret bruger af Microsoft Office-pakken
* Nysgerrig, lærevillig og god til at samarbejde med forskellige mennesker

Kan du ikke sætte flueben ved alle punkterne, vil vi stadig meget gerne høre fra dig - den rette kandidat kan se ud på flere måder!

**Vi tilbyder**

I Bravidas HSE-funktion arbejder vi med mere end regler og procedurer. Vi arbejder for at skabe en kultur, hvor sikkerhed, trivsel og arbejdsmiljø er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem dialog, samarbejde og involvering af mennesker.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at lære, udvikle dig og få indsigt i arbejdsmiljøarbejde i en stor organisation med mange forskellige fagligheder og medarbejdergrupper.

Hos Bravida bliver du samtidig en del af Nordens førende leverandør af tekniske installations- og serviceydelser. Vi arbejder som ét Bravida på tværs af fagområder og regioner, og vi værner om en kultur præget af engagement, ansvarlighed og samarbejde.

**Du får blandt andet**

* En studierelevant stilling med indsigt i arbejdsmiljø- og HSE-arbejde
* Tæt sparring og sidemandsoplæring fra vores HSE-koordinator
* Mulighed for at omsætte teori til praksis i en stor organisation
* Fleksibilitet i forhold til studie og eksamensperioder
* Et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab
* Arbejdsplads i Brøndby med 10-20 timer om ugen

**Lyder det som noget for dig?**

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Tøv ikke med at sende din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag, da vi holder samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte HSE-specialist, Cecilie Morgan, på [cecilie.morgan@bravida.dk](mailto:cecilie.morgan@bravida.dk) eller tlf. 25 25 30 73.

Bravida opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge.

En god bygning gør forskellen. Det er grundtanken bag Bravida. Vi er Nordens førende leverandør af tekniske totalløsninger inden for service og installation, og vi hjælper vores kunder med at skabe velfungerende og mere bæredygtige bygninger. Det er Bravidas langsigtede mål at være klimaneutral i hele værdikæden i 2045. Vi er 13.000 medarbejdere, heraf 3.000 i Danmark, i over 180 byer i Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Finland. Bravidas aktie er noteret på Nasdaq Stockholm. www.bravida.dk

jobs.title: Projektcontroller til økonomiafdeling
jobs.description_md:
Birkerød

# Projektcontroller til økonomiafdeling

## Et trygt sted for faglighed, forskellighed og ordentlighed

I Novafos er vi hverdagsmestre i at håndtere vand – rent vand i hanen, regnvand i byområder og renset spildevand til havet. Vi er mere end 450 dedikerede kolleger, der hver dag arbejder for at samfund og miljø kan trives i harmoni. Nu leder vi efter en controller til vores økonomiafdeling, hvor faglighed går hånd i hånd med et arbejdsmiljø, der er roligt, rummeligt og bygget på respekt og ansvarlighed.

## Et job med overblik, udvikling og mening

Som projektcontroller hos os får du en central rolle i økonomifunktionen, hvor din vigtigste opgave er at understøtte projektlederne i deres projekter og skabe økonomisk overblik for ledelsen. Vi har fokus på de store linjer og på, at projekterne kan gennemføres indenfor de rammer, som lovgivningen sætter.

Samtidig er vores projektcontrollerfunktion i udvikling. Vi vil gerne styrke understøttelsen af vores større projekter og programmer, og du får mulighed for at være med til at forme, hvordan vi arbejder med det fremover.

## Dine opgaver

Du bliver en vigtig del af økonomi- og regnskabsteamet på 15 kolleger og kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med:

* Projektcontrolling og økonomisk sparring med projektledere og ledere
* Kvartalsvis økonomiopfølgning
* Økonomisk overblik og materiale til ledelse og bestyrelse
* Understøttelse af større og komplekse projekter og programmer
* Sikring af at projekterne gennemføres indenfor lovgivningens rammer
* Vedligeholdelse og kvalitetssikring af økonomiske data og systemer
* Udvikling af vores projektcontrollerfunktion og arbejdsgange
* Ad hoc-forespørgsler og analyser

## Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der har en solid økonomisk ballast og trives i rollen som sparringspartner. Du kan både forstå det enkelte projekt og løfte blikket mod det samlede overblik, uden at have behov for at være nede i alle detaljer. Du:

* Har erfaring som controller, projektcontroller eller fra en tilsvarende økonomirolle
* Er udadvendt og trives med at sparre med ledere og projektledere
* Har blik for væsentlige økonomiske sammenhænge og kan skabe overblik
* Har lyst til at udvikle arbejdsgange og være med til at forme vores projektcontrolling
* Har måske erfaring fra forsyningsområdet og kendskab til den relevante lovgivning, men det er ikke et krav
* Trives med at arbejde tæt sammen i et team og samtidig have ansvar for egne opgaver
* Er dig selv, med dine styrker og særkender

## Ledelse og arbejdsmiljø

Du får en leder, der går op i god ledelse – ikke kontrol. Der er fokus på tillid, tydelige rammer og på at give plads til forskellighed i teamet. Her bliver der lyttet, taget hensyn og skabt rum for både fordybelse og trivsel.
Teamet er fagligt stærkt, roligt og præget af en god omgangstone. Der er plads til både stilhed, koncentration, grin og hygge – alt efter hvad dagen kalder på.

## Plads til et liv ved siden af dit arbejde

I Novafos tror vi på, at balancen mellem arbejde og fritid er afgørende for din trivsel og jobglæde. Vi respekterer dine arbejdstider og værner om et trygt og stabilt arbejdsmiljø, så du også har overskud til familie og privatliv. Derudover tilbyder vi:

* Fleksible arbejdstider og en arbejdsuge på 37 timer inkl. frokost
* Mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra efter aftale med nærmeste leder
* Gode ansættelsesforhold igennem KL-overenskomst, herunder fair løn og attraktiv pension
* Støtte til din faglige udvikling gennem kurser, intern undervisning og uddannelse
* Gode kontorfaciliteter på Blokken 9 i Birkerød, herunder aflåst cykelparkering samt gratis parkeringspladser til bil
* Kantineordning, træningscenter, massageordning, sundhedsforsikring
* En aktiv personaleforening og arrangementer som sommerfest, julefrokost, yoga, DHL-stafet mv.

## Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte os hvis du har spørgmsål vedrørende jobbet. Vi forventer at holde samtaler løbende og tage imod vores nye kollega efter nytår.

**Kontaktperson:
Martin Schørring Greve**
Økonomichef
44208269

---

*Novafos er et af Danmarks største vand- og spildevandsselskaber og forsyner borgere i Allerød, Ballerup, Egedal, Frederikssund, Furesø, Gentofte, Gladsaxe, Hørsholm og Rudersdal.
Som klimavenligt forsyningsselskab arbejder vi målrettet med bæredygtighed, klimasikring og udvikling af nye løsninger, der skaber værdi for både samfund og miljø.*
